cohorts.name: 中強光電股份有限公司

assumptions: No terminal receivables in this input case.
Terminal holdings use provided marked NAV, without hypothetical liquidation costs.
This analysis does not certify omitted data or actual broker execution.
method.attribution: Use cash ledger event_id; if absent, map action_id to the unique corporate action entitlement event_id, not whichever cohort is held on payment date.
method.closed_win_rate: Strictly positive final cash PnL among cohorts with an exit_date; remaining marked positions excluded from this win rate.
method.drawdown: Each daily NAV / the cumulative maximum of initial cash and all preceding/current daily NAVs - 1.
method.net_pnl: sell cash inflow + other attributed cash inflow + final marked market value - buy cash outflow; execution costs are already included in trade cash flows.
method.net_return: cohort net PnL / actual buy cash outflow
